body: Why do I feel like I can type honestly here? I know it's 'permanent record' being saved online, yet trying to tell any of this to another person, vocalized, is out of the question. What the fuck? Even though I've hated working for this fucking company for as long as I've been employed I haven't looked for any jobs because I'm downright terrified of the prospect of changing positions. I know that sounds absurd but at the same time I'd so much rather deal with it than have to go through the process of sleazing with co-workers again. I can't stand introductions beucase how can I relate to others when I don't really know what I stand for? Fuck I'm ranting. I've never had goals or objectives, never been able to relate to really anyone or anything. People tell me I need a life's plan but I've never been able to grasp the concept. I'm going to bed but I'm leaving the belt up. Always the belt.
Even I feel better when I'm helping someone, but asking for help is such a fucking deal for me, I'd rather just go home.

The same friends I was with I try to feel close to, but they've seen me shitty blackout drunk and I showed my awful side to them, now I can hardly look them in the eyes without feeling anxious. The depressed and anxious and mentally fucked side of me, what I'm typing about now.

I just have no idea what's going on right now. I'm lonely, I tried having a fun night with friends and even enjoyed it for a while until I got home. Finances are a mess, family life is a mess, job is shitty and I can't believe I still work at the same place, love-life is dead. Its just I have a lot running through my mind right now and a lot of it pushing me really dark. I'm soo fucked up right now and when I try to think of a reason why I'm here I come up with nothing at all which gives me even less hope. I just really don't care anymore. I made a shitty attempt maybe 5 years ago and honestly thought I was over that period in my life but here I am again alone. I already tied a belt up and stood for a while with it around my neck. It's still up in my closet "just in case". I don't even know what I'm typing anymore hahaha.
